title: Review repair G: a BLOCKED report with commits is never merged or closed
description:
Found by repair F (0c1) while fixing the teardown paths — a false-close path, so it is treated as a blocker. internal/exec/subprocess/collect.go:169-193 classify only asks whether a report exists, not what it says, and internal/reconcile collect only checks the verdict, so a worker that commits and reports STATUS: BLOCKED collects as ready-to-merge: its work is merged, gated and the tick CLOSED, with the escalation (report.NeedsHuman(), already computed into the role result) ignored. The fixtures never caught it because the blocked-first runner mode reports BLOCKED with no commit. Fix: make the reconciler refuse on RoleResult.Status (BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT are escalations, never a merge), or have classify return a needs-human verdict — pick the seam that keeps the executor honest about what the report says and the reconciler as the party that decides; document the choice in RESULT-G.md. Add a fake-runner mode that commits then reports BLOCKED (internal/reconcile/testdata/fake-runner.sh), and a test that the attempt is refused, torn down with its branch kept (disposeRejected path from 0c1), the tick stays open with the escalation surfaced, and nothing lands on the integration branch. Check the existing blocked-first test still holds. Use go test -short -timeout 45m for the reconcile package, foreground only.
